reason: The plugin primarily offloads deterministic multi-step agent tool orchestration into a DSL compiler and graph runtime, with optional experimental external-service tools.

summaries.zh: 将智能体中的确定性多步工具编排编译为受限 DSL，并通过图运行时执行以减少模型循环往返。
summaries.en: Compiles deterministic multi-step agent tool workflows into a restricted DSL and executes them through a graph runtime to reduce model-loop iterations.

capabilities: Compiles deterministic agent execution paths into a restricted DSL
Executes schema-validated DSL programs through a graph runtime
Discovers and invokes host-registered tools through the harness
Optionally exposes experimental GitHub, CRM, user, and email tools
